verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's own docs say the Inference API offers generated clients in Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Rust and Swift (Connect, gRPC and Protobuf), so you can install a client instead of hand-writing HTTP calls. That evidence covers only the Inference API; the Terraform provider is an infrastructure-as-code tool, not an SDK. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs for the CKS, Object Storage and billing APIs, documentation of the SDKs' depth, packaging and versioning, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Clients are available for the Connect, gRPC, and Protobuf ecosystems across languages including Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Rust, and Swift.
you can install a generated client instead of writing HTTP calls by hand.
